'''2013 Worlds Day 2 Ryan Washeleski DS Agents Of Black Sun''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Ryan Washeleski]] at [[2013 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Username Nicodarius.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince|Ref2-D-agentsofblacksun.gif}}
* '''Username:''' Nicodarius
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
